scope: Selected effective EC3 section 14.11.5 and Tables 401–402; not a full PDF/X, PDF/A or PDF/E conformance audit.
source: Physical pages 835–839, printed 820–824. The page-priority requirement and registered-condition example are on physical839/printed824; Table401 profile optionality is on837/822. #482 on839 corrects the URL file-specification description.

features.rule: Once a processor respects output intents, a page-level intent takes priority. A registered condition may omit DestOutputProfile.
features.code: output_intent::selected and in_force_on_pages both use first_usable on the page and fall back to the catalog when no embedded profile parses.
features.evidence: New public rendering and intent-report tests use registered CGATS TR001 on the page, no embedded page profile, and a different catalog GRACoL profile. Catalog-only is a positive profile control; page-only establishes the same page without the unrelated press. Both tests fail: [96,97,97,255] versus [64,64,64,255], and Catalog GRACoL is reported in force.
features.boundary: No registry fetch, invented ICC transform or rejection of a valid omitted profile is required. Declining an unavailable transform does not authorize borrowing another scope’s press.

features.rule: Table401 permits AToB for preview/proofing. NOTE1 leaves workflow selection among multiple intents outside the specification.
features.evidence: Current first-usable choice and preview direction are product choices; default spaces remain nearer source-color definitions. Existing tests cover color routes, page-intent names and print warnings.
features.boundary: The old page-selection unit test uses one profile for both scopes and asserts names; it does not independently prove different pixel transformations. Several naming-only fixtures omit required intent fields and are parser-policy evidence.

features.feature: Optional spectral data and external profile references
features.rule: MixingHints and SpectralData may explicitly be ignored. Table402 describes referenced ICC profile metadata; #482 clarifies URL file specifications.
features.evidence: No automatic profile fetch is performed. ADR1932 records the unavailable-reference reporting boundary.
features.boundary: No mandatory fetch or complete spot-color/prepress workflow inferred. This pass does not certify all external profile combinations.
